messages:
ankit shah: Heads-up: spotted intermittent asyncio CancelledError traces when closing AsyncClient in aiohttp-based sample apps too. Might be a broader async client lifecycle issue, not just uvicorn.

julia park: can you paste the smallest repro? is this happening with httpx transport or custom aiohttp one?

ankit shah: minimal gist: create an AsyncClient(), spawn a background task that awaits, call client.aclose() while bg is running. Sometimes bg finally doesn't run. Sounds similar.

kevin li: filing an umbrella issue RDW-async-lifecycle for eng-runtime. devex-bot: created issue #1305.

devex-bot: issue RDW-async-lifecycle (#1305) created by kevin li with linked repros and CI notes.

julia park: short-term doc note: in examples add a paragraph about shutdown ordering and recommended pattern (await app tasks then close client), and mention edge cases where users must close client last.

ankit shah: also noticed warnings about "Task was destroyed but it is pending!" in logs which looks noisy; we should suppress or handle during graceful shutdown.

kevin li: adding tests across 3.9-3.11 and anyio/asyncio matrix. I'll coordinate with QA.

ankit shah: thanks, will follow the ticket for patches.
